content: A simple way to use monolingual data in MT is to turn it into synthetic parallel data and let the training procedure run as usual BIBREF16 . In this section, we explore various ways to implement this strategy. We first reproduce results of BIBREF2 with BT of various qualities, that we then analyze thoroughly.
